subject: Your 70-day legacy moment
preview_text: You're not just using Smart Notes anymore. You're shaping what it becomes.
body_paragraphs: Seventy days ago, you downloaded an app to fix the chaos after meetings. Since then, you've turned countless conversations into clear action items. But here's what most people don't realize: you're not just a user anymore. You're part of something bigger.

Every summary you create trains our AI to understand how real people talk—your language, your industry, your team's shortcuts. That's why users who stick around see summaries that get sharper over time. Your feedback, your usage, your trust—they're the engine behind a tool that's quietly becoming indispensable for founders, students, and teams who refuse to forget key points.

And now, there's a feature that makes this mission tangible: the Shareable Notes. When you share a summary with your team, you're not just sending text. You're building a shared memory bank that your colleagues can search, comment on, and act on. It's async clarity, no more lost action items.

Open the app today and share your last meeting's summary with one teammate. See how that small act changes your follow-up flow. P.S. The best summaries come from people who use the language controls—try setting your profile language to match your meeting lingo, and watch the AI nail the context every time.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary
